entries.5b8d932441708cf2: Under its purpose, “One Step Further Beyond Your Dreams, Open the Future with You,” the company is carrying out a five-year medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ended March 2026 as its first year. The plan is to complete business structure reform early in the first three years to build a business base with competitive advantages, and to harvest results in the latter two years, and it sets its five-year end point as “establishing a financial model unique to Orico.” It states that it will further refine its strength, credit capability (credit, collection and operations), through technology and create new solutions.
